entries.title: Shorter car park hours
entries.body: Car park opening hours shortened from 7:00am-8:00pm to 7:00am-6:30pm from Monday 15 September 2026.

entries.title: Open riding season
entries.body: Open riding (horse riding off the designated riding routes) started at 00:01 on Friday 17 April 2026. End date for the season not stated on the source page.

entries.title: Baldwins Pond dam investigation works
entries.body: Cognition Land and Water Ltd is carrying out site investigations to inform future improvements to the Baldwins Pond dam. A public consultation is expected to follow, with construction expected to begin in spring (year not stated, presumably 2027).
